lines: I COMPARED MY SALARY TO MY WORKLOAD.
I CHECKED MY CALENDAR FOR NEXT WEEK.
I'LL BE DOING MY ACTUAL JOB
I DID THE MATH ON MY 3% RAISE.
AT THIS RATE, BY THE TIME I RETIRE,
I'LL FINALLY BE ABLE TO AFFORD
HR ASKED HOW TO IMPROVE MORALE.
MY COMPANY ANNOUNCED A NEW PERK:
MY BOSS SAID: "THINK OF THIS JOB AS AN INVESTMENT."
I ASKED WHEN I'D SEE THE RETURNS.
HE SAID: "OH, YOU'RE NOT THE INVESTOR."
MY JOB DESCRIPTION HAS SIX RESPONSIBILITIES.
IN REALITY, I'M ALSO IT SUPPORT,
MY COMPANY SAID RETURNING TO THE OFFICE
TO SIT ON ZOOM CALLS IN A CUBICLE.
MY BOSS SAID AI WON'T REPLACE ME.
THEN HE ASKED ME TO TRAIN IT.
MY COMPANY SAYS NO MORE LAYOFFS ARE PLANNED.
I KEEP A BOX UNDER MY DESK. JUST IN CASE.
MY BOSS TOLD ME TO TREAT CUSTOMERS LIKE FAMILY.
SO NOW I AVOID THEIR CALLS
